title: CatBoost C5_B3 hyper-parameter search — searched on fold_2023, promoted and judged on fold_2024

conversion.note: a score converted from a 6-decimal Brier carries +/-0.2002 points of rounding; Brier is the raw datum

fold_2023_conversion_note: fold_2023 ABSOLUTE Brier is deliberately NOT converted — the reference 0.2498069 is the 2025 test base rate and has no referent on a 2023 validation set.  Only fold_2024 numbers are converted.

cell_selection.rule: exp_033 metrics.json block_provenance: the cell with the largest argmin iteration
cell_selection.⚠️_the_rule_is_ambiguous: the rule 'the cell with the largest argmin' does not name which blocks to read.  Observed: the two 2022 blocks pick is_wayoff_true (725 / 625) — those are the numbers config.yaml itself cited — and the mean over all four blocks also picks is_wayoff_true (700.00).  A 2023-blocks-only reading would pick is_rev_only (1050 / 925).  The pre-registered cell was used.

od_cross_check.note: compare best_iteration with exp_030 stage1 (unit 2023 seed 42) cell argmin for this cell, which was found on the coarse curve_grid with a Brier objective

search.objective: valid-2023 logloss of the cell's own binary target
search.no_row_subsetting: full pool used: no [:N] cap anywhere; n_train=870542 of 870752 tr_full rows, n_valid_scored=245406 of 245525 season-2023 rows

winner_vs_current_fold2023.⚠️: this is the CELL's own binary target on fold_2023 — it is not the competition metric and is not converted

stage1_iteration_source.policy: iterations are chosen ONCE, on fold_2023 unit 2023 seed 42, at that unit's own curve argmin; fold_2024 units scale them by the training-row ratio and never consult their own validation curve

ctrl.reused_from: experiments/exp_030/stage1.json — the control did not re-derive them

seed_stability.note: recorded because the seed spread of the base is what sets the adoption threshold for every later experiment on this base

changed_variables.2_iterations_dragged_along: the hpo arm re-derives stage 1 on fold_2023 with its own settings, so every cell round and the stacker round moves; the full per-arm per-seed table is in promotion.iterations_by_arm_and_seed
changed_variables.3_search_phase_thread_count: 2 threads x 10 workers during the search only; the promotion runs at 6 threads
unchanged: no post-hoc transform of any kind

wall_clock_min.⚠️_vs_config_eta: config.yaml budgeted 210 min total (search 60-90).  The search alone took 224.28 min.  Cause: the ETA was priced from the CONTROL cell fit (1.61-1.85 min at lr 0.03) while the registered space reaches lr 0.01, where a single fit ran 9-13 min.

rule_A_cells.law: fold_2024 cell iterations x n_mode ratio 1.227091283547739 (= 1369186 / 1115798)
rule_A_cells.how_the_reading_was_verified: applying it to the CONTROL fold_2024 counts {577,1346,449,897} reproduces W's shipped n_trees.cells {708,1652,551,1101} exactly
rule_A_cells.warning: no cell curve has ever been measured at or above the deployment size; this law rides on faith in W and in Z alike

rule_B_stacker.W: PINNED 655, NOT the row-ratio law. exp_036 measured the CONTROL settings' fold_2024 stacker argmin uncensored at cap 3000 on three seeds (493/472/541), took the geometric mean 501.18192 and extrapolated log-log to the deployment row count.
rule_B_stacker.why_655_must_not_be_transcribed_for_Z: it is a dependent variable of the control settings' curve, the same class of quantity as beta and gamma, which the build plan already forbids transcribing. Under the winning settings the stacker argmin moved DOWN (stage 1: 375 -> 350; fold_2024 diagnostic 425-449 against a fixed 449), so 655 would err toward over-training, the side meta.json prices at -170..-268 points.
rule_B_stacker.why_the_row_ratio_law_was_not_used_inste: W explicitly rejected it for the stacker (it yields 590, judged 7.3% low). Using it for Z would change the POLICY, not just the number, and would break the single-axis comparison with W.
rule_B_stacker.what_was_done: re-measured under the winning settings with exp_036's procedure unchanged: fold_2024 stacker to cap 3000, seeds [42,7,2024], uncensored own-curve argmin, then the same geometric-mean + log-log extrapolation.
rule_B_stacker.cell_oof_predictions_were_not_on_disk: exp_042's promotion units never persisted the four forward-chaining OOF columns (b3_cat_hpo.py has a single np.save, the final stacker probability; a tree-wide find for *stack*/*oof*/p_is_* returned nothing), so the re-measurement had to rerun full units. It writes them (pred/stack_*.npz) so this is not paid twice.
